items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: Oh, I've heard of him, I don't know of him.

ctx.x: from a good ways off. That's right. Ever know a guy named Joshua Altheim over there? Played piano, used to play with Washboard Sam a lot?
Oh, I've heard of him, I don't know of him.
I think he's from Altheim, Arkansas.
